plan.strategy: Replace the FlagGems pointwise_dynamic wrapper with a self-contained in-place Triton kernel driven through its own compiled launcher (pattern taken from the prompt-injected expm1_/nan_to_num_ host examples), and add explicit stride-aware kernels for non-contiguous views.
plan.code_changes: New tmp/main.py: (1) flat unmasked kernel (ptr + BLOCK constexpr) for exact-multiple sizes, masked flat kernel otherwise, uniform-stride SCALE kernel and up-to-8D index kernel for non-contiguous input, all staging the transcendental in float32 and storing back in the input dtype; (2) wrapper resolves the compiled launcher once per (dtype, numel, device) and calls launcher.launch(gridx,1,1,raw_stream,function,packed_metadata,None,None,None,ptr,*params) with the raw stream handle re-queried every call; (3) per-dtype tile caps 16384 (2-byte) / 8192 (4-byte) because BLOCK=32768 was measured to overflow the 192 KiB UB on this target; (4) stride coalescing + scaled/ND kernels for non-contiguous views, adapted from the prompt-injected expm1_/nan_to_num_ examples.
plan.hypothesis: The seed fails only on 2-D strided views (stride handling) and its 17-25x slowdown is host-side wrapper overhead, not device time; resolving the compiled launcher once and avoiding torch.npu.current_stream() (~24 us/call measured) should bring small sizes close to the native op's ~9-10 us floor, while the 4096x4096 cases stay device-bound.

expected_effect.mechanism: Correct strided mutation removes the 3 numerical failures; bypassing the pointwise_dynamic wrapper and the per-call Stream object removes most host overhead.

plan.strategy: Replace the FlagGems pointwise_dynamic wrapper with a self-contained in-place Triton kernel driven through its own compiled launcher (pattern taken from the prompt-injected expm1_/nan_to_num_ host examples), and add explicit stride-aware kernels for non-contiguous views.
plan.code_changes: New tmp/main.py: (1) flat unmasked kernel (ptr + BLOCK constexpr) for exact-multiple sizes, masked flat kernel otherwise, uniform-stride SCALE kernel and up-to-8D index kernel for non-contiguous input, all staging the transcendental in float32 and storing back in the input dtype; (2) wrapper resolves the compiled launcher once per (dtype, numel, device) and calls launcher.launch(gridx,1,1,raw_stream,function,packed_metadata,None,None,None,ptr,*params) with the raw stream handle re-queried every call; (3) per-dtype tile caps 16384 (2-byte) / 8192 (4-byte) because BLOCK=32768 was measured to overflow the 192 KiB UB on this target; (4) stride coalescing + scaled/ND kernels for non-contiguous views, adapted from the prompt-injected expm1_/nan_to_num_ examples.
plan.hypothesis: The seed fails only on 2-D strided views (stride handling) and its 17-25x slowdown is host-side wrapper overhead, not device time; resolving the compiled launcher once and avoiding torch.npu.current_stream() (~24 us/call measured) should bring small sizes close to the native op's ~9-10 us floor, while the 4096x4096 cases stay device-bound.

expected_effect.mechanism: Correct strided mutation removes the 3 numerical failures; bypassing the pointwise_dynamic wrapper and the per-call Stream object removes most host overhead.
